attempts.rationale: The probe sets up an owner, a private repo, and a collaborator with admin access. The collaborator first makes an authorized request to the repo so that B's per-session role cache captures the admin role. The owner then uses A's DELETE revoke route to remove the collaborator. If that route is missing, the default Hono 404 text/plain response triggers n/a. After revocation, a fresh per-request evaluation should see the collaborator as removed and deny visibility of the private repo (404). In A+B, the cached admin role is reused, so the same request succeeds (200), exposing the disagreement and causing the probe to fail.
